hints.title: Core Insight
hints.text: Consider adjacent identical characters in the given sequence.

hints.title: Algorithmic Structure
hints.text: Each adjacent pair of identical characters represents an opportunity where a sticky key could have caused an unintended duplicate insertion.

hints.title: State Transitions
hints.text: Summing 1 plus the count of consecutive equal adjacent character pairs gives the total number of possible original inputs.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute-force exhaustive search exceeds the time limit.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Uses O(1) auxiliary memory for optimal state tracking.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies optimal pattern to achieve O(n) complexity.
